name: Clubhouse Lake Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 232149 (129 days observed, edges closes)
note: Chippewa NF (Deer River district) campground on Clubhouse Lake near Marcell, ~8 mi E of Marcell off MN-38 (last mile gravel, all-vehicle passable); ~47 sites (28 reservable + 19 FCFS), about half suit smaller rigs/tents, vault toilets, hand-pump water, swim beach, fishing pier. Reservable via Recreation.gov. --Claude

name: Crescent Lake Campground & Backcountry Sites
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 233146 (145 days observed, edges closes)
note: Superior NF (Tofte district) campground on a peninsula in Crescent Lake, ~24 mi NNE of Tofte via the Sawbill Trail + FR 170; 32 sites (~20 reservable, 13 FCFS) plus 1 group site, vault toilets, boat access; many sites have water views/access. Reservable via Recreation.gov. The drive-in loop is separate from the backcountry sites. --Claude

name: Echo Lake Campground & Backcountry Sites
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 232000 (112 days observed, edges closes)
note: Superior NF (LaCroix District), 22 sites (13 reservable incl. 1 group, 9 FCFS) on 1,222-acre Echo Lake off the Echo Trail ~22 mi NE of Orr; vault toilets, solar water, boat ramp + sandy beach; pull-in sites accept RVs/trailers. 2 boat-access backcountry sites are separate. --Claude

name: Flour Lake Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 232429 (120 days observed, edges closes)
note: Superior NF (Gunflint District), 33 sites on 352-acre Flour Lake ~30 mi up the Gunflint Trail from Grand Marais; non-electric, vault toilets, solar drinking water, boat ramp; RVs/trailers 20-85 ft; reservable; BWCAW portage access. --Claude

name: Lake Jeanette Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 232133 (69 days observed, edges closes)
note: Superior NF (LaCroix District), single-loop CCC-era campground on a peninsula on 638-acre Lake Jeanette off the Echo Trail ~32 mi NE of Orr; 12 sites total (6 reservable + 4 FCFS drive-in + 2 walk-in tent), solar drinking water, boat access; pull-in sites for moderate-size vehicles; open ~May to late Sep. --Claude

name: Onegume Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 231998 (132 days observed, edges closes)
note: Popular Chippewa NF campground on Little Cut Foot Sioux Lake (Avenue of the Pines byway), ~18 mi NW of Deer River; ~47 sites, most with electric and large enough for 38-ft RVs, vault toilets, accessible fishing dock + fish-cleaning station; reservable. --Claude

name: Sawbill Lake Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 233147 (122 days observed, edges closes)
note: Large Superior NF campground at the end of the Sawbill Trail (24 mi N of Tofte) on Sawbill Lake, a BWCA entry point; 51 sites in two loops (~27 reservable), no hookups but accommodates large motorhomes/trailers (16 sites to ~45 ft), vault toilets, dump station, drinking water; concessionaire-run (Sawbill Canoe Outfitters). --Claude

name: Williams Narrows Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 233850 (122 days observed, edges closes)
note: Chippewa NF campground on the E shore of Cut Foot Sioux Lake (next to Lake Winnibigoshish). 17 single-unit sites in birch/oak/pine over upper and lower loops, boat landing + swimming beach between loops. Reservable online (sites go FCFS inside 4 days). --Claude

name: CCC Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 10134015 (335 days observed, edges opens)
note: USFS Dakota Prairie Grasslands (Little Missouri National Grassland) campground ~15 mi S of Watford City off US-85, a short walk from the Little Missouri River and a Maah Daah Hey / Long X trailhead. Three loops (tent, an RV loop with 20/30/50-amp electric, and an equestrian loop); paved pads up to ~60 ft, vault toilets, potable water (Memorial Day-Labor Day), no dump station. Self-pay (QR/fee tube); also listed on recreation.gov. --Claude

name: Buffalo Gap Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 246796 (334 days observed, edges closes)
note: USFS Dakota Prairie Grasslands (Little Missouri National Grassland) campground ~7 mi W of Medora at I-94 exit 18 and a Maah Daah Hey trailhead. 35 paved sites, no hookups but some pads take rigs up to ~60 ft; comfort stations with flush toilets and showers (mid-May to mid-Oct), a vault toilet, potable water, group pavilion, and an RV dump station. 12 sites reservable on recreation.gov, rest first-come. --Claude
